fields.value: Approximately uniform pixel spacing with recurring small pre-complex candidates. Rhythm origin is unconfirmed, and the calibration hold prevents rate-, PR- or QRS-duration classification. No normal-rate, bradycardic or tachycardic category is assigned.
fields.basis: New independently reviewed educational synthesis of the exact original raster, conditional source measurements and stated course criteria; not a source-authored or educator-validated rhythm answer
fields.reason: Qualified ECG educator review has not occurred. Visible-deflection observations are supplied without validated P-wave identity. Numeric PR and QRS remain withheld. Optional educational comparison only, not a source-authored answer or confirmed rhythm diagnosis. A candidate atrial association is not proof of sinus origin. Timing retains the recorded calibration assumptions and holds. Interval envelopes apply to the selected endpoint-review cycles and describe boundary uncertainty, not actual beat-to-beat variability, normal conduction or a full-strip atrial census. These newly derived observations remain unscored and are not eligible as validated answer keys.

limitations: Wave observations and conditional endpoint envelopes remain provisional and unscored. QT/QTc, calibrated amplitudes and clinical diagnosis are not established. Selected-complex widths do not establish sequence certainty.
pr unresolved: Pixel envelope only. No seconds-based PR field is proposed.
qrs unresolved: Pixel onset/end bands for three complete positive-negative complexes only. No seconds-based QRS field is proposed.

Grid calibration failed a local-spacing check: detections at x281, x284 and x287 introduce two 3-pixel gaps, while x498 to x508 omits a grid line. A total of 151 detections was coincidental and does not establish 150 small squares. Time-converted R–R, bpm and six-second count rates are withheld. No timing ticks are printed.
Excluded x99,171,285,399,512,625,737 proposals: pre-QRS/T-wave or baseline features, not additional QRS.

P-wave text is a provisional description, not validated atrial identity. PR remains unresolved with no numerical answer. QRS remains unresolved with no numerical answer. Validated electrical boundaries and qualified educator adjudication remain outstanding.
Calibration assumes the course’s 25 mm/s convention, not speed metadata printed on each strip. Peak uncertainty is approximately ±2 source pixels, excluding errors in identifying the waveform.
